Definition: something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition
BiblicalUsage: 1) cattle, livestock; 1a) cattle, livestock; 1a1) in general of a purchasable domestic animal; 1b) cows, sheep, goats (in herds and flocks)
